title: Use macOS tab views for closely related content

statement.en: Use a macOS tab view for closely related content areas.
statement.ja: 密接に関連するcontent areaにはmacOS tab viewを使う。

conditions: Each tab's content needs to be similar or related to the content in the other tabs.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Tab views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるTab viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Label each macOS tab by its pane content

statement.en: Label each macOS tab to describe its pane's content.
statement.ja: 各macOS tabにpaneのcontentを表すlabelを付ける。

conditions: Prefer a noun or short noun phrase; a verb phrase can fit some contexts.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Tab views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Avoid pop-up buttons for switching macOS tabs

statement.en: Avoid using a pop-up button to switch macOS tabs.
statement.ja: macOS tabの切り替えにpop-up buttonを使わない。

conditions: A tabbed control exposes every choice and switches with one click or tap.
exceptions: A pop-up button can be reasonable when there are too many content panes to display as tabs.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Tab views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるTab viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Avoid more than six tabs in a macOS tab view

statement.en: Avoid providing more than six tabs in a macOS tab view.
statement.ja: macOS tab viewに6個を超えるtabを設けない。

conditions: At six or more tabs, consider another interface because tab layouts can become overwhelming.
exceptions: A pop-up-button menu can present view options when the tab count is too high.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Tab views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるTab viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
